label: Budget 2027 still not tabled on day one after the deadline
text: The чл. 79, ал. 4 ЗПФ deadline expired on 31 October with nothing in the parliamentary register, and the 1 November presidential runoff then displaced the file entirely; МС keeps pointing at "this week", i.e. after the runoff, so the draft now arrives after the constitutionally-anchored date with the ЗПС repeal (below) already in force.
